//: THE PERSIST-OR-LOSE LEDGER — named, shrink-only, read by check-derived-regenerable.
Every entry is a field path (element id elided) that a save/reload DESTROYS: it takes a
NEW value on every cycle, so no rebuild-from-authoritative will ever recover the authored
one. Measured, not asserted — __tests__/regenerable.cert.ts serialises and reloads TWICE
and puts a field here only when it is still moving on the second cycle.
READING HISTORY — the ledger has only ever shrunk, and it shrank twice in one session:
20:46  11 fields (incl. stair.<*>.metadata.createdAt / .modifiedAt)
21:50   9 fields — the two stair entries STRUCK. They stopped being measured when
another track's Wave-1 work landed, and check-derived-regenerable exited 3
STALE LEDGER until they were removed. That is the ledger doing its job: a
paid debt that stays on the books is where the next regression hides.
The same run also lost three REGENERABLE entries (the F-3 15 mm position.y
drift on plumbing + furniture, and the F-4 openings.* superset) — those are
not this ledger's, but they moved for the same reason.
CURRENT READING, 2026-08-11 21:50: 9 fields, and they are ONE defect wearing nine names —
F-1. The loader restores an element by re-running its Create*Command, which stamps a
fresh metadata.createdAt/modifiedAt from the wall clock. A clock reading cannot reach a
fixed point by construction, which is precisely why these land here and why the eight
REGENERABLE fields (_renderVersion, metadata.version, the openings.* superset from F-4,
the 15 mm position.y drift of F-3) do not: those are deterministic functions of the
snapshot and settle after one cycle.
NOT A TOLERANCE LIST. Nothing here is excused. Harness 1 still reports all eleven as
round-trip divergences and its DOCUMENTED_TOLERANCES list stays EMPTY. This ledger's job
is only to make the set NAMED — so that a TWELFTH field appearing is a gate failure
instead of a surprise — and to shrink as W1-3 (the audit-field contract: are createdAt /
modifiedAt / version authoritative or derived? C13 §2 demands byte-compatible round-trips)
is decided by ADR.
SHRINK-ONLY. A name that stops being measured must be struck from this file in the same
commit that fixes it, or check-derived-regenerable exits 3 STALE LEDGER.
Notably ABSENT, and worth stating because an earlier reading had them: ifcData.guid on
every kind, and the bare stair.<*> / beam.<*> identity loss (F-2). Neither is measured as
moving on this run. check-identity-roundtrip is the gate that owns those two and grades
them at hard-0 — they are not this ledger's to absorb.
